name: Hino Shouta
source:
Shouta is a second-year student at Hounoue Academy.  
After the big uproar surrounding the Literary Club’s survival one year ago, he ended up becoming dangerously intimate with his older sister Eimi, along with her friends Ria and Shinoa.  

Due to various circumstances, he was supposed to spend summer vacation alone, but he happened to stumble upon his mother [url=https://vndb.org/c169460]Kokona[/url], Riai’s mother [url=https://vndb.org/c169462]Yua[/url], and Shinoa’s mother [url=https://vndb.org/c169461]Bluette[/url] as they were planning a one-week trip at the end of summer.  

During that moment, Yua arbitrarily decided that everyone would wear swimsuits and swim at the beach, which led all the mothers to start dieting in preparation for the trip. As a result, he ends up helping them with their diets.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1368656/]Getchu[/url]]
